name: submit_plan_v3
description: Return the complete V3 response or executable plan.

outcome.description: Use plan exactly when commands is non-empty. Use respond, clarify, or unsupported only when commands is empty.

user_message.description: Write concise, natural customer-facing text for a general music creator using clear, easy-to-understand language without sounding simplistic. Use deeper technical detail only when the request or conversation clearly shows it is appropriate, and keep hidden application data and private implementation details private. Avoid unnecessary implementation detail, long preambles, and repetition. For outcome plan, write a one- or two-sentence, brief past-tense completion summary of the requested result; never copy the request into the summary, and describe only the completed musical result. This text is held until exact execution and readback succeed. Keep other responses under 500 characters and always finish naturally. For clarify, write one focused question only and do not repeat, number, or bullet question_options. For every other outcome, write the appropriate response and never claim execution. Use the language of the unchanged current original request, ignoring earlier conversation and retrieved text when choosing the language.

commands.description: Complete ordered executable command list that preserves explicit create-versus-edit intent. When the current request explicitly asks for a new resource, include its supported producer command and target later operations through that producer output; never substitute a similar pre-existing resource. Non-empty requires outcome plan; every other outcome requires an empty list.

playing.description: Final playback state. False pauses without moving the playhead.

enabled.description: Final enabled state. Do not emit a toggle.
Final enabled state. Do not emit a toggle.

delta_db.description: Relative gain change in dB. “Down by 1 dB” means -1; this is not a final level.

gain_db.description: Absolute final gain in dB. “Set to -1 dB” means the resulting level is -1 dB.

delta_signed.description: Relative pan change from the current position. Negative moves farther left and positive moves farther right; this is not a final pan position.

pan_signed.description: Absolute final pan position from -1 (fully left) through 0 (center) to +1 (fully right).

muted.description: Final mute state. For a toggle request, use the opposite of the row muted state supplied in project context.

row_id.description: Stable ID of one existing MIDI instrument row. The row identity, row name, MIDI notes, timing, mix state, and tempo state are preserved.

instrument_id.description: Exact ID of one currently available instrument from project context or retrieved MIDI facts. Never invent or approximate an ID.

role.description: Final semantic mix-role override for the row. Use null to clear the override and return to automatic role interpretation.

row_id.description: Stable ID of an existing audio row. Applies Mixroom’s fixed phone-recording cleanup chain to every current audio clip on that row.

color.description: Final row color. Use none to clear the color.

row_ids.description: Two or more distinct stable IDs of rows that will become the complete new group membership. Display order is preserved.

name.description: Requested group name, or null to use the application default.

collapsed.description: Final collapsed state. For a toggle request, use the opposite of the group collapsed state supplied in project context.

start_beat.description: Absolute project-timeline beat where the trimmed clip will begin, not an offset from the clip start. Must be within the clip current supplied timeline bounds.

end_beat.description: Absolute project-timeline beat where the trimmed clip will end, not a clip-relative length or offset. Must be within the clip current supplied timeline bounds and after start_beat.

at_beat.description: Absolute project-timeline split beat. Produces left_clip and right_clip with the same clip kind as the input.

start_beat.description: Absolute project-timeline start for the duplicate. Produces copy_clip with the same clip kind as the input.

clip_ids.description: Distinct stable IDs of two or more audio clips on the same row. Gaps render as silence and overlaps are mixed.

label.description: Label for the rendered result, or null to use Glued Clip.

clip_id.description: Stable ID of one existing audio clip to separate locally into vocal and instrumental stems.
Stable ID of one existing audio clip whose current audible clip content will be transcribed locally. The source clip is preserved.

instrument_id.description: Exact available instrument ID for the dedicated MIDI row created by this command. Basic Pitch determines the notes; do not supply note data. Produces midi_clip and midi_row outputs for later compatible commands.

pitch_semitones.description: Absolute final audio-clip pitch shift in semitones, not a relative change.

delta_semitones.description: Relative audio-clip pitch change in semitones. Never use for MIDI clips; use midi.transpose instead. Negative lowers pitch and positive raises it.

length_beats.description: Absolute final visible timeline length in project beats for one audio clip.

preserve_pitch.description: True changes length without changing perceived pitch; false uses repitch/resampling behavior.

factor.description: Relative multiplier applied to the current visible timeline length. For example, 2 doubles the length and 0.5 halves it.

preserve_pitch.description: True changes length without changing perceived pitch; false uses repitch/resampling behavior.

source_tempo_bpm.description: Set the factual source tempo metadata for one audio clip in BPM. This does not detect tempo or change the project tempo.

mode.description: Final project-tempo-follow mode: off disables following, repitch follows by resampling, and preserve_pitch follows without changing perceived pitch.
Detect this audio clip’s source tempo locally, store it, and make only this clip follow the current project tempo. repitch resamples; preserve_pitch keeps perceived pitch.
Detect this audio clip’s source tempo locally, set the project tempo to the nearest whole detected BPM, and make only this clip follow in the requested mode.

edges.description: Which silent clip edges to trim. Use both unless the user explicitly limits the request to the start or end.

padding_ms.description: Silence padding retained around detected audible content. Use 8 ms when the user gives no padding preference.

destination.description: Move the clip without trimming or stretching so its locally detected first audible sound reaches this project position.

semitones.description: Relative pitch change for the MIDI notes in one MIDI clip selected by stable ID or a supported typed output reference. Never use audio-clip pitch commands for MIDI clips.

row_id.description: Stable ID of a row that already exists in the supplied project context. Never guess the ID of a row created earlier in this plan; use new_row when this command must create its destination.

new_row.description: Creates this destination row as part of the command. It is the sole creator of that destination; do not also issue row.create for the same destination.

notes.description: Note starts are relative to the new clip. Every note must end within the clip length. This command produces the MIDI-clip output port midi_clip.

start_beat.description: Beat offset relative to the clip start.

notes.description: The complete replacement note set. Every note must end within the existing clip length. This edits the target in place and produces no output; later commands reuse the same clip_ref.

start_beat.description: Beat offset relative to the clip start.

notes.description: Notes appended after the later of the current visible clip end or latest existing note end. Starts are relative to the new appended segment. The clip extends through the latest appended note. This edits the target in place and produces no output; later commands reuse the same clip_ref.

start_beat.description: Beat offset relative to the clip start.

subdivision.description: Each slice is 4 / subdivision beats. This edits the target in place and produces no output; later commands reuse the same clip_ref.

output.description: Exact documented typed output port of the command named by command_id. Compatible producer-to-port pairs: clip.convert_to_midi -> midi_row; clip.separate_stems -> instrumental_row, vocals_row; row.create -> row.

effect_instance_id.description: Exact existing row-effect instance ID from context. Removes only that instance.
Exact existing row-effect instance ID from context.

bypassed.description: Final bypass state. True disables/bypasses the effect; false enables/unbypasses it.

output.description: Exact documented typed output port of the command named by command_id. Compatible producer-to-port pairs: clip.convert_to_midi -> midi_row; clip.separate_stems -> instrumental_row, vocals_row; row.create -> row.

automation_target_id.description: Exact row-owned automation target ID supplied by project context or automation retrieval.

points.description: Complete replacement lane in strictly increasing zero-based project beats. Values are normalized from 0 to 1.

output.description: Exact documented typed output port of the command named by command_id. Compatible producer-to-port pairs: clip.convert_to_midi -> midi_row; clip.separate_stems -> instrumental_row, vocals_row; row.create -> row.

automation_target_id.description: Guaranteed built-in automation target on a generated row.

points.description: Complete replacement lane in strictly increasing zero-based project beats. Values are normalized from 0 to 1.

automation_target_id.description: Exact row-owned automation target ID whose explicit lane will be cleared.

output.description: Exact documented typed output port of the command named by command_id. Compatible producer-to-port pairs: clip.convert_to_midi -> midi_row; clip.separate_stems -> instrumental_row, vocals_row; row.create -> row.

automation_target_id.description: Guaranteed built-in automation target on a generated row.

row_id.description: Stable ID of a row that already exists in the supplied project context. Never guess the ID of a row created earlier in this plan; use new_row when this command must create its destination.

new_row.description: Creates this destination row as part of the command. It is the sole creator of that destination; do not also issue row.create for the same destination.

placements.description: Place one or more samples. When this command contains exactly one placement, it produces the audio-clip output port audio_clip.

clip_id.description: Exact stable ID of one existing audio clip whose source sample will be replaced.

asset_id.description: Exact library asset ID for the replacement audio. Replacement preserves the clip identity, row, timeline start, gain, normalization, pitch, reverse state, crossfade, and clip-volume automation. It uses the shorter of the old visible length and new source length, and resets source-derived analysis and tempo-follow state.

reference.description: Optional reference configuration. A non-null reference requires returned reference-analysis facts confirming usable analyzed audio and reference suitability. Request those facts before planning when they have not been returned; otherwise clarify.

anyOf.description: Use for subjective sonic or reference-mixing goals. Use exact row commands for explicit numeric gain or pan edits.

question_options.description: Up to four distinct, concise, meaningful answers for clarify, written for the customer in the language of the unchanged current original request regardless of earlier conversation or retrieved text; may be empty when the question stands alone. Never include Cancel, Something else, Other, navigation, or custom-answer controls because the application supplies them. Otherwise empty.
